purpose: Represent planned housing separately from the demographic baseline with explicit completion, occupancy, household-size and migration-source assumptions.

completionPct.rationale: Share of planned dwellings assumed completed.

occupancyPct.rationale: Share of completed dwellings assumed occupied.

personsPerDwelling.rationale: Manual sensitivity range; auto mode should use SCB-derived occupancy defaults.

externalSharePct.rationale: Share of residents new to the FA rather than redistributed within it.

internalSharePct.rationale: Share of residents redistributed from other FA municipalities to the host municipality.

phaseYears.rationale: Years over which the scenario effect is phased in.

low.label: Låg befolkningseffekt
low.interpretation: Sensitivity setting, not a probability statement.

reference.label: Referenskänslighet
reference.interpretation: Middle sensitivity setting for comparison, not a most-likely forecast.

high.label: Hög befolkningseffekt
high.interpretation: Upper sensitivity setting, not a probability statement.

validationRequirements: housing scenario remains excluded from baseline
FA external effect equals new-to-FA residents only
internal redistribution sums to zero across FA municipalities
scenario effect is monotonic across low/reference/high presets when all else is fixed
SCB auto occupancy defaults remain the preferred household-size source
governance: Presets are sensitivity scenarios, not forecasts or probabilities.
Planned dwelling count, municipality, dwelling type, tenure and size remain explicit user inputs.
Auto persons-per-dwelling should use the latest available SCB-derived occupancy default; manual override remains visible and explicit.
Do not calibrate housing scenario parameters against the same future population outcome used to evaluate the baseline.
